sinMarca: Pick a brand above to set up its Brand Kit.
intro: The brand colors, the text style, your logo in a corner and, if you want, a call to action at the end. It applies automatically to all the brand's clips; in each clip's editor you can change the style and turn off the logo and the call to action. Clips already processed pick it up when you process them again.

estilo.ayuda: How the hook and captions look on the brand's clips, with its colors. Each clip can change it in the editor. It's saved with the Brand Kit.

logo.ayuda: PNG with a transparent background, if you have one. We remove the background anyway.

cta.titulo: Call to action at the end
cta.ejemplo: Watch the full episode on YouTube
cta.conEstilo: It goes in the center, in a box in your primary color, with the style's font.
cta.sinEstilo: It goes in the center, in a box, with the brand's hook colors.

guardado: Saved. New clips already come out like this.

vista.ayuda: The hook lasts the first few seconds and the call to action only shows up at the end; here they're always visible so you can adjust them.
vista.zonaSegura: Whatever falls outside the dotted line is covered by the network.
